about: The sigma_v prior-width scan: all seven sigma_v prior widths multiplied by a common factor s (s_finite, plus flat), the fit without alpha_2 (model B + tilts on the pessimistic linear-bias prior, alpha_2 and its tilts fixed at 0; the paper model at s = 6) fitted to the truth alpha_2 = +12.5 h^-2 Mpc^2 in every group. Per layout and cut: the shifts ((w0, wa) in its ellipse, Omega_m and A_s in their sigma) and max_shift, the largest of the three; fom_ratio and fom_om_as_ratio, FoM(w0, wa) and FoM(Omega_m, 10^9 A_s) of that fit over the reference model's (model B + tilts, alpha_2 free, sigma_v at s = 1); passing: the smallest s with every shift below shift_threshold and the FoM ratio there, interpolated linearly in log s between the scanned values (how: scanned, interpolated, flat only, fails). lrg_only, elg_only: the same with only the LRG or the ELG sigma_v widened, the others at s = 1. k_max is the z = 0 value of a per-bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i). None: no band kept. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL.ipynb (section 11, item 5, final-tier caches).
